en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 2. My father (RA) said: `Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim said, on the authority of Muhammad ibn `Isa ibn `Abid, on the authority of Yunus ibn `Abd al-Rahman, on the authority of Hamzah ibn Muhammad al-Tayyar that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said: “
There is nothing which causes fear or delight which is devoid of will [mashiyyah], destiny [qada’] and trial [ibtila’].”
